answer.origin: Finance.yahoo.com reported that NN, Inc. announced the expansion in late June 2026; the article was published 2026-07-01, and gives no separate date for NN’s announcement.
answer.note: NN reportedly plans to add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid-cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks. NN also reportedly said all of this new capacity was already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards, and targeted US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026. This is a supplier-side signal of planned capacity and reported demand that could support supply for NVIDIA-related AI racks, conditional on the capacity being brought into production and the awards serving those racks. It does not establish that NVIDIA is a customer or award counterparty, that NVIDIA placed orders, or that NN’s 2026 target is realized revenue from NVIDIA. The target is NN’s stated business target, not a reported result.
limitations: The award counterparties and whether any award is directly with NVIDIA are not identified.
The article does not specify the capacity’s commissioning or delivery schedule, nor the production volume represented by the 47 machine centers.
The scope and timing basis of NN’s US$80–US$90 million 2026 new-business target are not detailed, and the target is not a reported realized amount.
follow_up: Check NN’s original announcement and subsequent filings or earnings disclosures for award counterparties, any direct NVIDIA relationship, the definition and timing basis of the 2026 target, and customer/program attribution.
Check subsequent NN disclosures for installation, qualification, and production ramp timing at Wuxi and for evidence that the reported pre-sold capacity is serving NVIDIA-related rack programs.
Review NVIDIA disclosures and supplier or partner announcements for independent confirmation of a direct NN relationship or related sourcing.
